title: Şamanlar Tanrılar Ateistler
author: Sadık Usta
description: Shamans, Gods, Atheists explores one of humanity’s most complex and enduring questions: why do humans believe, and could we ever exist without belief? Drawing on a cultural and intellectual journey spanning more than 50,000 years, Sadık Usta traces the emergence of belief from early human awareness of death to the explosive rise of symbolic thought and creativity. From the shamanistic age and cave art to burial rituals, Göbeklitepe, and the birth of polytheistic religions, the book examines the anthropological, cognitive, and philosophical roots of faith and doubt.
